meta.source: L2J High Five datapack (Shagooh/l2j-server-datapack main), quest Java + html
howToClick: 2. If the NPC's default page has a 'Quest' link and the quest page is not shown directly, click 'Quest'.
3. If a quest list appears (several quests at this NPC), click the entry containing questTitle.
4. Click each text in clicks[] in order (lowercase substring match on the visible link text).
5. autoOnTalk=true: opening the dialog / Quest link is enough; the server advances the quest in onTalk.
meta.matching: Compare lowercase, trimmed link text with includes(); texts are the datapack originals, L2Toggle may change wording.
